title: Second-page coproduct comparison for lower-truncated direct image epi
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $E_i\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category] have an ambient coproduct cofan $\iota_i:E_i\to S$ in $D(\mathcal O_X)$. Using canonical lower truncation [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category], for every $a,r\in\mathbb Z$ and $p\in\mathbb N$, with $Rf_*$ as in [def-pc-derived-direct-image], the canonical map $\bigoplus_i H^p(Rf_*(H^r(\tau_{\ge a}E_i)[0]))\to H^p(Rf_*(H^r(\tau_{\ge a}S)[0]))$ induced by $H^r(\tau_{\ge a}\iota_i)$ is an epimorphism.

source.place: Tag 08DZ, bounded-below spectral-sequence reduction, with Tag 015J

proof.text: Choose representative complexes for the ambient family. Apply derivedAmbientDirectSums and transport its cohomology comparison to the given colimit cofan by coconePointUniqueUpToIso. This proves that ordinary derived cohomology carries the given cofan to a colimit cofan, naturally in the coprojections. For a <= r, the proven natural isomorphism H^r -> H^r tau_GE(a) from the standard t-structure transports this colimit. For r < a, all objects of the cohomology cofan, including its point, are zero, and IsColimit.ofIsZero proves the colimit property. Both private helpers are completely proved in Lean.

Apply the ordinary higher-direct-image coproduct epimorphism theorem to the resulting cohomology cofan. Use the natural comparison supplied by sheafCohomologyAndHigherDirectImages between schemeModuleHigherDirectImage f p and ordinary rightDerived p. Naturality identifies the desired Sigma.desc map with the composite of the coproduct of the comparison isomorphisms, the ordinary comparison epimorphism, and the inverse comparison at the coproduct point. The outside maps are isomorphisms, so the composite is epic.

proof_origin.place: V3 Lean reduction: fully proved cohomology/truncation transport; ordinary higher-image surjectivity isolated

mathlib_searches.query: Higher direct image sheaves commute with arbitrary coproducts of quasi coherent modules under a quasi compact quasi separated morphism of schemes

For a quasi compact quasi separated scheme morphism, the map from the direct sum of higher direct images of quasi coherent cohomology sheaves to the higher direct image of their coproduct is surjective

from.place: Tag 08DZ, second-page coproduct step in the bounded-below spectral-sequence reduction

theorem truncated_directImage_secondPage_coproduct_epi
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (I : Type u) (E : I → schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (S : schemeDerivedCategory X) (ι : ∀ i, (E i).obj ⟶ S)
    (hc : IsColimit (Cofan.mk S ι)) (a : ℤ) (p : ℕ) (r : ℤ) :
    Epi (Sigma.desc (fun i ↦ (schemeModuleHigherDirectImage f (p : ℤ)).map
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) r).map
          ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE a).map (ι i)))))
